topic: Student and youth protests against education cuts, rising tuition fees and austerity (Paysage/programme decree) in the French-speaking communities
scale: Hundreds to thousands of school and university students and youth across Wallonia and Brussels; ~500 detained since 1 Oct incl. at least 200 minors (per WSWS)
quote1: “When we saw nothing was changing without protests, we decided we would start,” said Amelia Di Salve, a 19-year-old studying to become a teacher, who added that protests in “France did influence us a little”.
quote2: Police in Belgium arrested 195 people on Saturday, as hundreds of school and university students marched in Brussels and Liège against education cuts.
